newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom to rank 10th in DAX share index.
newsitem.headline: Telekom to rank 10th in DAX share index.

text.p: The newly-listed shares in Deutsche Telekom AG will hold a weighting of about 4.5 percent in the German 30-share DAX index and so rank 10th among the components of the index, the German bourse said on Monday.
Werner Seifert, chief executive of Deutsche Boerse AG, told a news conference that other shares already in the DAX would have to "make way" for the new share.
Allianz AG, the largest share in the DAX, would have its weighting reduced to 9.6 percent from 10 percent, he said.
He added that the fact that the share is taking a significant position in the index meant that there would have to be considerable adjustment in investment portfolios.
"This meant that "a real flood of orders" could be expected over the next few days, Siefert said.
